note: La salle des cadres: loft room over the paint-pot room (west half), camera facing north. Dusty-lavender plaster, pale grey boards, pale grey roof beams; landmark = the wall of empty frames in every shape with a mobile of geometric shapes, plus the big round porthole in the west gable looking down on the square (fountain, clock tower). Feminine nouns on the left (la forme, la ligne, la pointe, la surface); masculine on the right (le point, le coin, le bord, le symbole, le trait, le cercle). Spiral stair in the back-left corner goes DOWN to the paint-pot room (R_colors_01); the blue door on the right (east) opens on the lemon-yellow measuring room (R_shapes_02). Zones: z1 = the drafting table by the blue door (right); z2 = the lower left of the frame wall (left).
